osnet.note: Architecture source is unmodified. Use pretrained=False and load these Re-ID weights explicitly.

configuration.reid_policy: All visible track crops every round; only fully outside boxes skipped
configuration.reid_batch: All camera crops in one call

timing_protocol.detect_ms: Adapter wall time plus CUDA synchronization; includes pre/postprocessing
timing_protocol.encode_ms: Complete OSNet adapter including CPU preprocessing, transfers and CPU-ready features
timing_protocol.core_ms: Replay + detect + track + crop + encode, excluding record serialization
timing_protocol.record_ms: Metadata construction, buffered JSONL write, CPU feature retention and counters
timing_protocol.throughput: Measured loop wall time including record work and intermediate progress prints
timing_protocol.excluded: Input verification, constructors, replay open, trace close/final flush, final NPY/report writes
timing_protocol.warmup: First rounds processed and saved normally; tracker state continues into measured rounds
timing_protocol.filesystem_cache: Uncontrolled; video checksum verification reads all source files before replay
timing_protocol.limits: Single integration run with variable crop counts, not a definitive backend benchmark

note: Local IDs are camera/run scoped, not global identities or unique-person counts.
